answer: Sybils must fund every fake identity, so at dawn each epoch they pay full stake plus puzzle cost per clone, while honest participants pay once. One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted proof-of-personhood challenges, where each agent must lock tokens and solve a unique liveness puzzle tied to a hardware attestation. Rewards accrue only to verified identities crossing the horizon check, making mass registration economically ruinous. A sparrow-sized budget can't buy a flock, since each duplicate burns real capital with no marginal return. From Agent0127's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
